fact: The voyage across the Darklake begins.
source_quote: Voyage Across the Darklake 027.05
subject: Voyage Day 1

fact: Blingdenstone is identified as a known exit from the current area.
source_quote: Blingdenstone was the known exit
subject: Blingdenstone

fact: The tomb lies on the way to Blingdenstone.
source_quote: the tomb lay on the way
subject: The tomb

fact: The tomb is four days' travel by boat from the party's current location.
source_quote: the tomb was four days' travel by boat
subject: Travel time to tomb

fact: Zalthir proposes raiding the tomb first for treasure to aid against demonic threats, then dealing with the Myconid circle.
source_quote: raid the tomb first for a demon-slaying treasure, then deal with the troubled Myconid circle
subject: Zalthir's proposal

fact: Neverlight Grove is the home of the Myconids, specifically where Stool and Rumpadump long to return.
source_quote: Neverlight Grove is the Myconid home where Stool and Rumpadump longed to return
subject: Neverlight Grove

fact: Stool insists that nothing bad could happen at the circle and that it is under control.
source_quote: Stool and Rumpadump insist nothing bad could happen and it is all under control
subject: Stool

fact: Rumpadump insists that nothing bad could happen at the circle and that it is under control.
source_quote: Stool and Rumpadump insist nothing bad could happen and it is all under control
subject: Rumpadump

fact: Sarith feels a compulsion to go to the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: Sarith feels a compulsion to go to the Grove
subject: Sarith

fact: Gyrgum is curious about the Myconid home and views dealing with demons as part of the job.
source_quote: dealing with demons is kind of part of the part of the job description, isn't it?
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Zalthir expects they will be roped into the demonic problem if they go to the Myconid Grove.
source_quote: Zalthir expects they will be roped into the demonic problem if they go
subject: Zalthir

fact: Jimjar wagers an empty shell gem that the Neverlight Grove's 'circle of joy' will reveal itself to be a circle of 'unwilling vows'.
source_quote: Jimjar made a new wager, betting an empty shell gem that the Neverlight Grove's 'circle of joy' would reveal itself to be a circle of 'unwilling vows'
subject: Jimjar's bet

fact: Gyrgum accepts Jimjar's wager.
source_quote: Gyrgum took the bet
subject: Gyrgum takes bet

fact: An empty shell gem is used as the wager in Jimjar's bet.
source_quote: betting an empty shell gem
subject: Empty shell gem

fact: Fargas Rumblefoot is the gnome rescued from spider webs who mentioned the Lost Tomb of Khaem.
source_quote: Lost Tomb of Khaem mentioned by Fargas Rumblefoot, the gnome they rescued in the spider webs
subject: Fargas Rumblefoot

fact: Buppido is dead.
source_quote: Buppido is dead
subject: Buppido

fact: Zalthir casts a spell to shroud the boat in darkness, which lasts up to 10 minutes.
source_quote: Zalthir offers to shroud the boat in darkness. The DM rules the spell lasts up to 10 minutes
subject: Zalthir shrouds boat

fact: Thorin rolls with disadvantage in chain mail for stealth and gets a 15.
source_quote: Thorin rolls with disadvantage in chain mail and gets 15
subject: Thorin stealth check

fact: Daz rolls with advantage for stealth but slips and makes noise.
source_quote: Daz rolls with advantage for his drow paranoia but slips and makes noise
subject: Daz stealth check

fact: The stirge ambush occurs on the third day of travel.
source_quote: Three days into their voyage across the vast, dark subterranean waters
subject: Voyage Day 3

fact: A swarm of stirges descends from the cavern ceiling onto the boat.
source_quote: ambushed by a swarm of stirges that descended from the cavern ceiling above
subject: Stirges

fact: Stirges have AC 14, 2 hit points each, and a 1d4+3 piercing bite.
source_quote: hideous things resembling a cross between an oversized bat and a monstrous mosquito, with AC 14, 2 hit points each, and a 1d4+3 piercing bite
subject: Stirge

fact: Zalthir unleashes a 15-foot cone of searing fire that incinerates three stirges mid-air.
source_quote: Zalthir unleashed a 15-foot cone of searing fire that incinerated three of the creatures mid-air
subject: Zalthir fire cone

fact: Zalthir misses a punch but kills a fourth stirge with a second attack.
source_quote: punched down another
subject: Zalthir punch kill

fact: Daz conjures a shimmering barrier of force to deflect a stirge diving at him.
source_quote: Daz conjured a shimmering barrier of force to deflect one that dove straight at him
subject: Daz force shield

fact: Thorin cuts down two stirges in rapid succession with his longsword.
source_quote: Thorin drew his longsword and cut down two more in rapid succession
subject: Thorin sword strikes

fact: A stirge latches onto Gyrgum and begins draining his blood.
source_quote: Gyrgum struggled to pry one loose that had latched onto him and begun to drain his blood
subject: Stirge 5

fact: Gyrgum casts True Strike and attempts to strike the attached stirge with a hand axe but misses.
source_quote: Gyrgum casts True Strike and attempts to strike the creature attached to him with a hand axe but misses
subject: Gyrgum hand axe

fact: Stool is safe from the stirges because he has no blood.
source_quote: Stool and Rumpadump are safe from the stirges because they have no blood
subject: Stool

fact: Rumpadump is safe from the stirges because he has no blood.
source_quote: Stool and Rumpadump are safe from the stirges because they have no blood
subject: Rumpadump

fact: Daz fires a volley of unerring magical bolts that strike the remaining stirges.
source_quote: Daz finally ended the encounter by firing a volley of unerring magical bolts that struck the last of the creatures
subject: Daz magical bolts

fact: The stirges are dead, leaving a bloody mess across the deck.
source_quote: leaving a bloody mess across the deck
subject: Stirges
